front.title: Deterministic Conformance Profile and Test Vectors for Evidence Qualification Receipts

abstract.t: This document defines a deterministic conformance profile and test- vector corpus for Evidence Qualification Receipts (EQRs). The profile, named eqr-core-1, makes receipt conformance mechanically reproducible: strict JSON structure, SHA-256 digest encoding, UTC timestamp handling, evidence-reference integrity, requirement-state derivation, and three-valued PASS, FAIL, or INDETERMINATE results are checked by a closed algorithm. The profile is intentionally narrow. Conformance does not establish that evidence is true, that a proposition is scientifically valid, that an issuer is trustworthy, or that an action is authorized. The goal is interoperable verification of receipt semantics, not promotion of conformance into substantive truth.
